title: Private Equity-Backed Group Acquires Regional SUD Treatment Chain
summary: A multi-state addiction treatment provider was acquired this week, continuing a wave of consolidation in the substance use disorder treatment space.

title: New CMS Rule Could Expand Coverage for Gambling Disorder Treatment
summary: A proposed CMS rule would broaden reimbursement pathways for gambling disorder treatment programs, a historically underfunded corner of behavioral health.

title: Eating Disorder Startup Expands Virtual Intensive Outpatient Program
summary: The digital-first eating disorder treatment company announced expansion of its virtual IOP into six new states.
